newsitem.title: USA: Kiwi Air to resume service to Orlando, Las Vegas.
newsitem.headline: Kiwi Air to resume service to Orlando, Las Vegas.

text.p: Kiwi International Air Lines said it will resume service to Orlando and Las Vegas on April 18, its first expansion since the low-cost carrier restarted operations in January.

Privately held Kiwi returned to the skies Jan 20 after suspending flights on October 15 as part of its Chapter 11 bankrutpcy reorganization. With the addition of Orlando and Las Vegas, Kiwi will now operate 212 weekly flights.
"KIWI is coming back, and our first expansion just three months after restarting is a very positive sign," said Kiwi Chief Executive Jerry Murphy.

"We are pleased with our growth over the past two months, and are now in a position to expand. Orlando and Las Vegas were good markets for us last summer, and we are going back to capitalize on peak season travel," Murphy said.
The introductory round-trip fare for each market is the cost of a one-way ticket plus $1. Tickets must be purchased before midnight April 6, and travel complete by April 24, the airline said.
